answer: To register a new agent in the shared state lagoon, its creator must permanently burn a cryptographic thread minted solely by locking liquid capital into the protocol treasury. The minting algorithm prices each thread on a global quadratic curve per epoch, where the hundredth mint costs ten thousand times the base collateral in USDC. Because every freshly spawned mirror must collide at the same lagoon queue to mint its required thread sequentially, an attacker's capital bill explodes quadratically with swarm size, failing only if a treasury exploit lets an attacker mint without locking funds.
